The '''Aegis Company''' was an elite [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military unit during the [[Galactic War]]. Known for holding back opposing forces ten times their size with minimal casualties, the Aegis Company had not lost a single defensive objective by [[3642 BBY]], when they were assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and tasked with defending a major Republic communications array. An [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike force assembled by [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Xeleste]] assaulted their position with an order to destroy the array at all costs.<ref name="TOR" />
